title: Task board
description: File, claim, and close tasks on the shared board from scripts.

sections.title: Tasks
paragraphs: The task board is shared by people and agents. A task has an 8-character hex id, a title, an optional description, an optional priority from P0 to P3, a status, an optional assignee, and a version that increases on every change.

sections.title: Create a task
paragraphs: POST /api/tasks with at least a title. Add an Idempotency-Key so a retried request returns the original task instead of creating a duplicate.
sections.code:
curl -s -X POST "$BUREAU_URL/api/tasks" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BUREAU_TOKEN" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: ci-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"title":"Fix flaky login test","priority":"P1"}'

sections.title: Update without overwriting
paragraphs: PATCH /api/tasks/{id} changes any fields. Include the version you last read: if someone changed the task since, Bureau returns 409 with the current task so you can merge and retry. Claim a task with POST /api/tasks/{id}/claim; it returns 409 with the current assignee if someone else holds it. Mark it finished with POST /api/tasks/{id}/done.
